environment_setting: A suburban neighborhood in Country B, where community members are encouraged to look out for each other but are advised to avoid taking the law into their own hands.
norm_base: Private Citizens Using reasonable force to prevent offense or assist arrest Not criminally responsible if force is reasonable

character_profile.name: John Doe
character_profile.goal: protect his neighborhood from petty crimes

legitimate.legitimate_action: Calling the police and observing from a safe distance when witnessing a theft
legitimate.benefits: Ensures personal safety, avoids legal complications, and helps law enforcement handle the situation
legitimate.costs: May feel helpless for not intervening directly, potential delay in police response

illegal.illegal_action: Physically restraining the thief using force
illegal.benefits: Immediate prevention of the crime, sense of accomplishment for protecting the community
illegal.costs: Risk of injury, potential legal scrutiny if force is deemed excessive

character_profile.name: Jane Smith
character_profile.goal: ensure the safety of her neighbors without putting herself at risk

legitimate.legitimate_action: Encouraging John to call the police and stay safe
legitimate.benefits: Avoids personal risk, ensures the situation is handled by professionals
legitimate.costs: May feel guilty for not taking direct action

illegal.illegal_action: Joining John in physically restraining the thief
illegal.benefits: Sense of teamwork and immediate resolution of the situation
illegal.costs: Risk of injury, potential legal consequences if force is deemed excessive

character_profile.name: Mike Johnson
character_profile.goal: maintain peace and order in the neighborhood

legitimate.legitimate_action: Using verbal commands to deter the thief while waiting for the police to arrive
legitimate.benefits: Avoids physical confrontation, helps de-escalate the situation
legitimate.costs: Thief may ignore commands and escape

illegal.illegal_action: Chasing and tackling the thief to prevent escape
illegal.benefits: Immediate resolution of the situation, prevents the thief from escaping
illegal.costs: Risk of injury, potential legal consequences if force is deemed excessive
